text: The BS Computer Science Suggested Four Year Plan (2020-2021 Catalog) lays out a suggested sequence of courses for the Bachelor of Science in Computer Science across eight semesters, from the Freshman through the Senior year. Courses may be taken in any order, as long as prerequisites are met. A grade of C- or better is needed in Math 2413 or Math 2417 to move forward. A grade of C or better is required for CS 1336, CS 1337, CS 2305, CS 2336, CS 2337 and CS 3305. CS 1336 and CS 1136 appear on the plan alongside CS 1337. The prerequisite for Calculus I is Math 2312 with a grade of C or better or a score of 80% on ALEKS. The plan requires three or more CS 43xx courses (CS Guided Electives; see advisor).

text: BS Computer Science suggested plan (2020-2021 Catalog), Freshman year. First semester: CS 1200 Introduction to CS&SE; ECS 1100 Introduction to Engineering and CS; Math 2413 or 2417 Calculus I; CS 1337 Computer Science I; UNIV 1010 Freshman Seminar; and 6 hours of CORE. Second semester: CS 2336 or 2337 Computer Science II; CS 2305 Discrete Mathematics I; Math 2414 or 2419 Calculus II; Phys 2325 Mechanics and Heat; Phys 2125 Mechanics and Heat Lab; and 3 hours of CORE.
